annotation.equivalence_rationale: All three responses preserve the same decision-relevant evidence for the three criteria: they clearly explain that the replacement is accepted but awaiting warehouse confirmation, they avoid unsupported delivery-date promises while setting the expectation of later update, and they provide a follow-up mechanism via contact details/case reference/case number or recording contact details for proactive update. Differences in tone, phrasing, or minor wording do not change the criterion-level evidence.
